campaign_thesis: An invitation to the Signal Garden, providing Copper Finch customers a reflective space to view aggregate ecosystem health and existing support context without pressure or individual tracking.
tone_rules: Avoid all sales pressure or outcome promises.
Prioritize ethical clarity and transparency over engagement metrics.

email_invitation.subject: A space for reflection on your ecosystem health
email_invitation.preheader: View aggregate trends and your current support context.
body_paragraphs: We have prepared a space called the Signal Garden where you can view your current ecosystem health through adoption and user trends.
This view is based on aggregate account-level metrics to provide a high-level perspective on your usage patterns.
You can also acknowledge existing support interactions within this space, including any open cases currently on file.
This environment is designed for reflection, allowing you to review trends and choose your next steps at your own pace.

message_claims.message: View your current ecosystem health through adoption and user trends.
source_claims: View your current ecosystem health through adoption and user trends.

message_claims.qualification: Reflects the presence of an open case without speculation.

transparency.why_received: You are receiving this because your account has shown changes in feature adoption and user trends.
transparency.data_boundary: All information presented represents aggregate account-level observations and does not explain specific user behavior.
transparency.choice_statement: You can exit this experience at any time without consequence.

measurement_plan.interpretation: Measures the interest in viewing aggregate ecosystem health.
measurement_plan.guardrail: No increase in support ticket volume or sentiment decline.

measurement_plan.interpretation: Measures if the aggregate-only view meets user expectations for non-intrusiveness.
measurement_plan.guardrail: No increase in unsubscribes from email communications.

manager_handoff.executive_summary: Launched the Signal Garden recovery experience for Copper Finch customers. The implementation uses React 19 and provides an aggregate-only view of ecosystem health and support context to mitigate privacy concerns and user frustration.
decision_questions: Does the aggregate-only data boundary sufficiently address potential privacy concerns for our Copper Finch segment?
Is the 'Signal Garden' naming convention aligned with our brand's tone for reflective experiences?
operational_dependencies: SignalStrand component must correctly render aggregate metrics from the Copper Finch data stream.
Support context must accurately reflect open case existence without pulling sentiment data.

risks.risk: User feels monitored due to granular signal display.
risks.mitigation: Use aggregate signals only; never show individual user events.
Acknowledge the case as a known item without making promises.

required_disclosures: Information is for informational purposes and does not explain specific user behavior.
You can exit this experience at any time without consequence.
